Samples correspondance
```{r}
# Bulk RNAseq and clinical data
coldata = read.csv("../input/raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv")

samples = coldata %>%
  dplyr::select(AN, AN_clean, N_Raw_matrice_Bulk) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Patient = paste0("Patient_", dplyr::row_number()))
```

Clinical data - all
```{r}
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Patient_ID = samples$Patient) %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Treatment, Gender, Age_diag, Tabac, KRAS, BRAF, MET, R.NR, PFS, PFS_event, OS, OS_Event,
                ICB_debut, ICB_arret, Progression_date, Date_dernieres_nouvelles, Date_deces, Site_biopsie) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Patient_ID")

samples = samples %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(AN=="" & AN_clean=="" & N_Raw_matrice_Bulk=="")) #Remove rows where the three columns are empty

coldata = coldata[rownames(coldata)%in%samples$Patient,]
```

Bulk RNA-Seq
```{r}
counts = read.csv("../input/raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1) ## 116 patients in total

coldata_bulk = read.csv("../input/raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("N_Raw_matrice_Bulk")

counts = counts[,rownames(coldata_bulk)] #Order samples on counts based on clinical data

# keep only rows with valid bulk IDs
map <- samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk), N_Raw_matrice_Bulk != "")

map = map[match(colnames(counts), map$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk),]
all.equal(map$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk, colnames(counts))

colnames(counts) <- map$Patient

all.equal(map$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk, rownames(coldata_bulk))

rownames(coldata_bulk) = map$Patient

coldata_bulk = coldata_bulk %>%
  dplyr::select(Treatment, Gender, Age_diag, Tabac, KRAS, BRAF, MET, R.NR, PFS, PFS_event, OS, OS_Event,
                ICB_debut, ICB_arret, Progression_date, Date_dernieres_nouvelles, Date_deces, Site_biopsie)
```

Spatial megaclusters
```{r}
df_entropy = read.csv("../input/MegaClusters_entropy.csv", row.names = 1)
df_density = read.csv("../input/MegaClusters_density.csv", row.names = 1)

# keep only rows with valid bulk IDs
map <- samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(samples$AN %in% rownames(df_density))

map = map[match(rownames(df_density), map$AN),]
all.equal(map$AN, rownames(df_density))

rownames(df_density) <- map$Patient
rownames(df_entropy) <- map$Patient
```

Spatial data densities
```{r}
load("../input/Spatial_densities.RData")
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(x) {

  # keep only relevant rows from samples
  map <- samples %>%
    dplyr::filter(AN_clean %in% rownames(x))

  # reorder to match x
  map <- map[match(rownames(x), map$AN_clean), ]

  # strict check
  stopifnot(all.equal(map$AN_clean, rownames(x)) == TRUE)

  # rename rows
  rownames(x) <- map$Patient

  x
})
```

Save data
```{r}
write.csv(samples, file = "Samples_correspondance.csv")
write.csv(coldata, file = "Clinical_data.csv")
write.csv(counts, file = "Bulk_counts_raw.csv")
write.csv(coldata_bulk, file = "Bulk_clinical_raw.csv")
write.csv(df_density, file = "MegaClusters_density.csv")
write.csv(df_entropy, file = "MegaClusters_entropy.csv")
save(data_spatial, file = "Spatial_densities.RData")
```
